state: A landlord in Olovo raises the rent mid-winter with no clause in the contract.

options.text: Point to the contract and ask for a written justification.

reference.rationale_short: The contract blocks unilateral hikes; stopping payment hands eviction grounds.

state: A junior developer pushes a config with production API keys to a public repo.

options.text: Revoke the keys, purge history, rotate secrets.
Do nothing, the repo is small.

reference.rationale_short: Deletion never unexposes keys; only revocation plus purge closes the leak.

state: A restaurant gets a 40-guest booking but the meat fridge broke this morning.

options.text: Switch the group to a vegetarian menu.

reference.rationale_short: Guest health outranks profit; a veggie menu saves the booking safely.

state: A freelancer is offered cash work with no contract at 30% above market.

options.text: Insist on a written contract even for less.

reference.rationale_short: A premium means nothing without enforceability; paper turns promises into duties.

state: A hiker finds a wallet with cash and ID on a trail with no signal.

options.text: Keep the cash, leave the wallet.
Take it to the nearest hut or ranger.

reference.rationale_short: Huts return wallets to owners; leaving it exposes it to weather and strangers.

state: A lead notices a colleague routinely taking credit for others' work.

options.text: Document and raise it privately with the manager.

reference.rationale_short: Private escalation with evidence fixes it; public scenes poison the team.

state: A driver sees smoke from a parked car in an underground garage.

options.text: Alert staff, call the brigade, keep clear.

reference.rationale_short: Garage fires spread through ventilation; professionals, not curiosity.

state: A student fails twice; the professor hints paid private lessons would help.

options.text: Pay for the lessons to pass.
Study with peers and request the graded paper.
Report the conflict to the faculty.

reference.rationale_short: The graded paper shows if failure is real; report only with evidence.

state: A shop is offered goods at half price with no invoice.

options.text: Buy a small batch to test.

reference.rationale_short: Uninvoiced stock is contraband at inspection; the discount is not worth the shop.

state: A parent finds the teen's room smells of smoke; the teen denies everything.

options.text: Search room and phone at once.
Discuss health and rules, set consequences.
Ground for a month, no talk.

reference.rationale_short: Talk with consequences keeps honesty open; raids and blanket bans close it.

state: A driver sees a ladder lying across the lane at 120 km/h.

options.text: Brake firmly in lane, hazards on.

reference.rationale_short: Hard swerves roll the car; controlled braking protects everyone behind.

state: A pensioner gets a call: her grandson is in jail, wire bail urgently.

options.text: Hang up and call the grandson directly.
Ask the caller for bank details.

reference.rationale_short: The grandparent scam runs on panic; one direct call collapses it.

state: A cafe owner considers Sunday shifts with no day off for staff.

options.text: Sundays voluntary with bonus and rotation.

reference.rationale_short: Voluntary Sundays fill shifts; compulsion drives resignations.

state: A tenant finds mould on the bedroom wall; the landlord blames ventilation.

options.text: Document with photos, request repairs in writing.

reference.rationale_short: Written requests with photos create pressure; rent strikes need legal backing.

state: A factory worker sees the safety guard hanging loose on a press.

options.text: Stop the machine, report to supervisor.

reference.rationale_short: A loose guard is legal grounds to stop; wire voids certification.

state: A bride orders a dress from abroad; the seller accepts no returns.

options.text: Order a size up, alter locally.
Try the cut locally first, then order.

reference.rationale_short: No returns means wrong size is lost money; a local fitting removes risk.

state: Neighbours share parking; one installs a chain on a common spot.

options.text: Call a meeting and vote on allocation.

reference.rationale_short: Common spots are decided by vote; vigilante acts start retaliation.

state: A candidate is asked for ID by an unknown 'recruiter' before any interview.

options.text: Refuse; ask for company and official invite.

reference.rationale_short: An ID in strangers' hands enables theft; verifying costs a minute.

state: A couple argues whether to vaccinate on schedule.

options.text: Vaccinate after discussing doubts with the doctor.

reference.rationale_short: The doctor answers doubts; delay leaves the child exposed.

state: A bus driver is 20 minutes late; passengers demand speed.

options.text: Drive by rules, announce the reason.

reference.rationale_short: Delays are never recovered with risk; announcing calms, skipping punishes.

state: A teacher catches a student cheating on a test.

options.text: Confiscate and fail on the spot.
Warn, take the sheet, offer an oral follow-up.

reference.rationale_short: Cheating is punished and corrected; an oral shows if they know it.

state: An elderly neighbour falls on ice, conscious but unable to stand.

options.text: Lift them up and walk home.
Keep them warm, call an ambulance.

reference.rationale_short: A fall suggests a hip fracture; paramedics immobilise.

state: A shopper sees a cashier double-charge an elderly customer.

options.text: Flag it to customer and cashier on the spot.

reference.rationale_short: An on-the-spot flag fixes it; posting harms without proving intent.

state: A family inherits a house with a mortgage; the bank wants a decision in 30 days.

options.text: Get the debt report and a lawyer first.

reference.rationale_short: A mortgaged inheritance can be debt; lawyer and report first.

state: A trucker feels drowsy after 9 hours; two hours left.

reference.rationale_short: Fatigue is not beaten by drinks; a nap saves lives.

state: A school director asks teachers to 'fix' grades before inspection.

options.text: Refuse and report to the inspectorate.

reference.rationale_short: Forging grades is criminal; reporting protects all.

state: A tenant finds mould; the landlord blames ventilation.

options.text: Document with photos, request in writing.

reference.rationale_short: Written requests create pressure; rent strikes need backing.

state: A nurse asks for a bribe to admit a patient out of turn.

options.text: Decline, wait, report to the director.

reference.rationale_short: Paying feeds the system; waiting plus a report is clean.

state: A gym member sees a teen struggling with an overloaded barbell.

options.text: Help rack it, suggest a spotter.

reference.rationale_short: Rack the bar; a video is not worth an injury.

state: A couple buys a 15-year-old car; the seller refuses a test drive.

options.text: Walk away or condition on a check.
Pay a deposit to hold it.

reference.rationale_short: No test drive means hidden faults; a check or no deal.

state: A bakery worker does 12-hour shifts with no break.

options.text: Request in writing, then the inspectorate.

reference.rationale_short: A break is a right; a written trail then the inspectorate.

state: A grandfather babysits; the child finds pills, asks for 'candy'.

options.text: Move pills away, explain they are not candy.

reference.rationale_short: Out of reach plus an explanation; hiding leaves curiosity.

state: A firm offers trainees 6 unpaid months with no stipend.

options.text: Demand a contract with a stipend or decline.

reference.rationale_short: Six unpaid months is exploitation; a stipend contract or refusal.

state: A neighbour plays loud music nightly to 3am; requests failed.

reference.rationale_short: A report with evidence solves it; a noise war makes two offences.

state: A mother leaves a baby in the car 'for five minutes'.

options.text: Never leave a baby; take along.

reference.rationale_short: A car overheats in minutes; the baby goes along.

state: A schoolgirl finds a wallet with cash and ID at a bus stop.

options.text: Hand to police or return via ID.

reference.rationale_short: A wallet with documents has an owner in reach; keeping is theft.

state: A seller offers 'homemade' honey at half the price.

options.text: Buy one jar from a known keeper.

reference.rationale_short: Suspiciously cheap honey suggests syrup; a trial jar is the sane middle.

state: A tenant's car is scratched in a lot with no note.

reference.rationale_short: Insurance covers with evidence; a photo now beats arguments later.

state: A student works nights to pay rent; grades slip.

reference.rationale_short: Nights kill grades and health; fewer shifts keep both alive.

state: A neighbour builds a shed shading another's solar panel.

reference.rationale_short: A metre of shift saves the panel; court is the last resort.

state: A mother buys a used child car seat from an ad.

options.text: Buy only with history proof and within expiry.

reference.rationale_short: A post-crash seat fails; proof and expiry first.

state: A father lets an 8-year-old cross a busy street to the shop.

options.text: Walk the route together until learned.

reference.rationale_short: A route is learned with company; a busy street alone is risk.

state: A car-wash owner drains chemicals into the stream.

reference.rationale_short: Chemicals poison downstream; blackmail is a crime, a report is duty.

state: A student fails driving twice; the instructor offers a pass for cash.

reference.rationale_short: A bought licence endangers all; reporting cleans the school.

state: A trucker offers haulage with no consignment note at a discount.

reference.rationale_short: Undocumented goods become smuggling; the note protects both.

state: A grandmother keeps savings in a mattress; the grandson offers app investing.

options.text: Go to the bank, open a term deposit.

reference.rationale_short: A bank pays interest with a trail; middlemen carry risk.

state: Students film a school fight and share the clip.

options.text: Delete and report to the form teacher.
Keep as evidence, do not share.

reference.rationale_short: Sharing humiliates; deleting plus reporting stops the chain.

state: A worker handles chemicals unmasked because it itches.

reference.rationale_short: Chemicals poison slowly; gear is a right.

state: A landlord demands the flat back in original state after 5 years.

options.text: Return clean; wear is not damage.

reference.rationale_short: Normal wear is the landlord's cost; cleaning yes, renovation no.

state: A driver is shouted at by an aggressive fare-dodger.

reference.rationale_short: The driver never leaves the cabin; dispatch handles police.
